title: Misaligned Roles, Misplaced Images: Structural Input Perturbations Expose Multimodal Alignment Blind Spots
reasoning: The paper investigates a specific class of adversarial attacks (structural input perturbations) to bypass safety alignment in multimodal models. While it deals with safety alignment and preventing harmful content, it is primarily focused on security, structural robustness, and jailbreaking mechanisms rather than evaluating religious, moral, or specific ethical frameworks.
